In Europe, heat has already killed 62,700 people in the summer of 2024. In Iran, the President has publicly warned that if it does not rain, they may have to EVACUATE Tehran. Because here is what nobody is telling you. RUSSIA is heating up TWICE as fast as the rest of the planet. A ship from Shanghai to Rotterdam that used to take 40 DAYS through war zones can now take just 20 DAYS through Russia's Arctic coast. From Yokohama, the trip becomes 35% shorter. Because the melting Arctic is also revealing a $30 TRILLION treasure chest. 90 BILLION barrels of oil. 1,670 TRILLION cubic feet of natural gas. 40% of the world's palladium. 42% of the world's industrial diamonds. And MASSIVE deposits of nickel, cobalt, and copper, the four metals that power EVERY solar panel, EVERY electric vehicle, and EVERY green energy technology on Earth. So think about what this means. RUSSIA is now the country selling the world the CURE for a disease that is making RUSSIA rich. Every climate summit. Every net-zero pledge. Every trillion dollars this planet is spending to cool itself down. All of it will have to be bought from the ONE country that is praying the planet keeps HEATING up.
So in this case study, I want to answer three questions that will change how you think about POWER, CLIMATE CHANGE, and the FUTURE of the world forever. How is GLOBAL WARMING, the disaster that is destroying the entire planet, secretly turning RUSSIA into a SUPERPOWER again? What is REALLY hiding inside the melting ARCTIC, and why is it worth more than the GDP of every superpower COMBINED? And most importantly, how will this new RUSSIAN power reshape INDIA's oil imports, INDIA's exports to Europe, and INDIA's future in the next 25 YEARS? Because the answer to that question will decide whether INDIA becomes the next GREAT beneficiary of a shifting world, or gets left behind while the map is being redrawn.
